description:
Clang contracts a*b+c into FMA by default (arm64 especially), which gives float results that differ from Elixir in the last bit: a divergence under the one rule. Decided in 'How are kernels checked against Elixir mode?' (defk-dtw.16): float results must be bit-exact with Elixir mode.

Add -ffp-contract=off to lib/defk/build.ex; never -ffast-math or reassociation. Float reductions that would need reordering to vectorise stay in order (document as a limit if it costs).

Done when the flag is in the build and a test with an a*b+c kernel matches Elixir bit-exactly on inputs where FMA would differ.
title: Build kernels with -ffp-contract=off
